name: Guerrero sling materials
aliases: TVT versus Pelvicol versus autologous fascial sling
question: How do retropubic TVT, Pelvicol porcine dermis, and autologous fascial slings compare for primary surgery in women with urodynamic stress urinary incontinence?

design.blinding: investigator and outcome assessor masked per trial registry
design.population: Women in four UK units requiring primary surgery for urodynamically proven stress urinary incontinence.
design.locator: Guerrero 2010, PubMed abstract, Design/Methods/Results; ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01057550, Study Design and Arms

verdictNote: Pelvicol had lower patient-reported improvement; TVT and autologous fascia did not differ significantly.
takeaway: In women undergoing primary stress-incontinence surgery, Pelvicol porcine-dermis slings had lower one-year patient-reported improvement than retropubic TVT or autologous fascial slings (61% versus 93% and 90%); TVT and autologous fascia did not differ significantly.

reports.label: One-year primary report
reports.citation: Guerrero KL, Emery SJ, Wareham K, et al. "A randomised controlled trial comparing TVT, Pelvicol and autologous fascial slings for the treatment of stress urinary incontinence in women." *BJOG.* 2010;117(12):1493-1502. doi:10.1111/j.1471-0528.2010.02696.x

results.measure: Improved at 1 year; overall three-arm comparison
results.note: Pelvicol was inferior; the abstract reports no significant TVT–AFS success difference. Outcome-specific denominators were not reported.

results.measure: Improved at 6 months; overall three-arm comparison
